summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — attested only among the wooers who came against Odysseus' house.

story.text: Apollodorus names Hagius among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Thersilochus and before Clymenus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
